abilene.line: Until he's trapped in an alley in Abilene
stanza: Well, outside the law your luck will run out fast
And a few years came and went
Until he's trapped in an alley in Abilene
With all but four shells spent
High on amphetamines
The moon is a light bulb breaking
It'll go around with anyone
But it won't come down for anyone

gasoline.line: Because with a match that's mean and some gasoline
stanza: And when I wake up in the morning
I won't forget to lock the door

stanza: And I would have stayed if you'd asked me to
Stood outside till my lips turn blue
I wouldn't have blamed you

'Cause it's what you needed so bad

magazine.line: And I thought I wouldn’t have to be with you, a magazine
stanza: And I thought I wouldn’t have to be with you, a magazine

magazine.line: On a chair with a dead magazine
stanza: Oh I want you, I want you, I want you
On a chair with a dead magazine
In the cave at the tip of the lily
In some hallway where love's never been
On a bed where the moon has been sweating
In a cry filled with footsteps and sand
And then the system of strings tugs on the tip of my wings
(cut from cardboard and old magazines):
Makes me warble and rise, like a sparrow
And in the place where I stood, there is a circle of wood —
A cord or two — which you chop, and you stack in your barrow
And it is terribly good to carry water and chop wood
Streaked with soot, heavy-booted and wild-eyed;
As I crash through the rafters
And the ropes and the pulleys trail after
And the holiest belfry burns sky-high
Autumn came around like a drifter to an onramp
There were wet leaves floating in gutters full of rain
Took to walking barefoot around town
Melodies from grade school, kicking in my brain
Saw you on the crosstown bus today
You were reading a magazine
I turned my face away and I shut my eyes tight
And dreamed about the flowers that hide from the light on dark hillsides
In the hidden places

magazine.line: Amongst the vending machines and year-old​ magazines
stanza: Amongst the vending machines and year-old​ magazines
In a place where we only say goodbye
It stung like a violent wind that our memories depend
On a faulty camera in our minds
And I knew that you were a truth I would rather lose
Than to have never lain beside at all
And I looked around at all the eyes on the ground
As the TV entertained itself

And when she gets his gun, he's begging, "Babe, stay, stay
Stay, stay, stay"
This is the Ministry Of Remains
This is the Ministry Of Remains

marlene.line: Then you came home without Lili Marlene
stanza: Oh, the last time we saw you, you looked so much older
Your famous blue raincoat was torn at the shoulder
You'd been to the station to meet every train
Then you came home without Lili Marlene
And you treated my woman to a flake of your life
And when she came back, she was nobody's wife
